''Czarne syrenki'' (Black Mermaids) – women's team | ground = [[General Kazimierz Sosnkowski Municipal Stadium|General Kazimierz Sosnkowski Stadium]] | capacity = 7,150{{cite web|url=http://ekstraklasa.org/index.php?typ=klub&id=17|title=LOTTO Ekstraklasa – Strona oficjalna|website=ekstraklasa.org|access-date=7 May 2018|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130828010024/http://ekstraklasa.org/index.php?typ=klub&id=17|archive-date=28 August 2013}} | pattern_la1 = _apollon2627t | pattern_la2 = _poloniaw2627a | pattern_b1 = _poloniaw2627h | pattern_b2 = _poloniaw2627a | pattern_ra1 = _poloniaw2627h | pattern_ra2 = _poloniaw2627a | pattern_sh1 = _poloniaw2627h | pattern_sh2 = _poloniaw2627a | pattern_so1 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm1 = 000000 | leftarm2 = ff0000 | body1 = 000000 | body2 = ff0000 | rightarm1 = 000000 | rightarm2 = ff0000 | shorts1 = 000000 | shorts2 = ff0000 | socks1 = 000000 | socks2 = ff0000 | clubname = Polonia Warszawa | image = Poloniawarszawa1.svg | upright = 0.8 | fullname = Polonia Warszawa S.A. | short name = KSP (''Klub Sportowy Polonia'') | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1911|11|19}} | owner = [[Grégoire Nitot]] | chairman = Grégoire Nitot | manager = [[Piotr Stokowiec]] | season = [[2025–26 I liga|2025–26]] | league = [[I liga]] | position = I liga, 6th of 18 | current = | website = {{URL|http://kspolonia.pl}} }} '''Polonia Warsaw''' ({{langx|pl|Polonia Warszawa}}, {{IPA|pl|pɔˈlɔɲa varˈʂava|pron}}), founded on 19 November 1911, is the oldest existing [[sports club]] in [[Warsaw]], the capital of Poland, best known for its [[Association football|football]] and [[basketball]] teams. It also has [[track and field]], [[Swimming (sport)|swimming]], [[chess]],{{cite web|url=http://www.poloniachess.pl/|title=Klub Szachowy Polonia Warszawa|website=poloniachess.pl|publisher=KSzP|access-date=2022-07-30}} [[mountain biking]], and [[contract bridge]] sections. Historically it also had sections in [[ice hockey]], [[fencing]], [[tennis]], [[volleyball]], [[Czech handball|''hazena'']], [[Cycle sport|cycling]] and [[boxing]]. The football team competes in the [[I liga]], the second level of the [[Polish football league system]].
